[[File:Krepauk-SWG.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Huntmaster Krepauk]]
'''Huntmaster''' was a title created by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. The job of a Huntmaster was to test the hunting prowess of the travelers of Kashyyyk's many hunting trails by giving them a series of increasingly difficult hunts to undertake. The Wookiee [[Krepauk]] was the Huntmaster of the [[Rryatt Trail]] near the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Rwookrrorro/Legends|Rwookrrorro]].

A Huntmaster was also on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He spoke to possible Great Hunt contestants who were competing for the final spot in the Great Hunt. A [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] was then sent out on three [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]] taking the hunter across the planet.
